grade_rationale: 4 P1 findings — exceeds C-grade threshold (max_p1: 2). Primary spec coverage 0% — below C-grade minimum of 40%.

grading_config.F: Reserved for: exploitable auth bypass + critical domain failure

escalations.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (RCE)
Vitest Arbitrary File Read and Execution via UI Server

p1_findings.title: Primary Spec (dev-workflow-platform.md FR-001–069) Entirely Unimplemented
p1_findings.detail: Source/ implements the Self-Judging Workflow Engine (FR-WF-001–013 + FR-dependency-*). None of FR-001–069 from the primary spec appear in Source/ as // Verifies: comments. The running application is a different product from what the primary spec defines.
p1_findings.impact: Any agent following CLAUDE.md spec-first rule will build the wrong product. No compliance audit against primary spec is possible.
p1_findings.recommendation: Decide canonical spec direction: deprecate dev-workflow-platform.md or begin implementation. Update CLAUDE.md and inspector.config.yml accordingly.

p1_findings.title: Traceability Enforcer Produces False-Positive PASS on Primary Spec
p1_findings.detail: The mandatory verification gate targets only Plans/self-judging-workflow/requirements.md (most-recently-modified plan), not Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md. Gate exits PASS while 69 primary FRs are unimplemented.
p1_findings.impact: Every CI run and agent receives false confidence. Gate cannot catch regressions in primary spec.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add second enforcer invocation targeting Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md, or enumerate all Specifications/*.md files. If primary spec is deprecated, remove it.

p1_findings.title: Handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.impact: Remote Code Execution if any code path processes untrusted Handlebars templates

p1_findings.title: Vitest Arbitrary File Read and Execution via UI Server (CVSS 9.8)
p1_findings.impact: Remote Code Execution when Vitest UI server is listening on a network-reachable interface. Zero-authentication exploit.
p1_findings.remediation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vitest@^3.2.6 (major version change required)

p2_findings.title: Two Logger Modules — Undocumented Wrapper Creates Import Ambiguity
p2_findings.detail: src/utils/logger.ts is canonical; src/logger.ts is an undocumented re-export wrapper. New files may import either, breaking the single log sink rule.
p2_findings.recommendation: Merge to one file or document canonical path and add eslint no-restricted-imports rule.

p2_findings.title: WorkItemDetailPage.tsx (426 ln) and workflow.ts (374 ln) Approaching 500-line Limit
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract AssessmentList, ActionBar sub-components from WorkItemDetailPage. Split workflow.ts into workflow.ts + dependencies.ts.

p2_findings.title: Frontend Components Modified in Last 14 Days With Zero Tests
p2_findings.recommendation: Add component tests with // Verifies: FR-WF-009/010/011 traceability comments.

p2_findings.title: browserslist — Memory Exhaustion and Prototype Pollution
p2_findings.remediation: npm update browserslist in both modules

p2_findings.title: form-data — Multipart Upload Denial of Service
p2_findings.remediation: npm update form-data in both modules

p2_findings.title: js-yaml — YAML Deserialization RCE on Untrusted Input
p2_findings.remediation: cd Source/Backend && npm update js-yaml. Audit all call sites for untrusted YAML input.

p2_findings.title: vite Dev Server — CORS Bypass (Direct Dependency)
postcss — Regular Expression Denial of Service in CSS Parser

p3_findings.title: Two eslint-disable Suppressions Without Justifying Comments
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline comment explaining why react-hooks/exhaustive-deps is suppressed, or refactor with useCallback.

p3_findings.title: DebugPortalPage Uses Non-Standard Free-Text Verifies Comment
p3_findings.recommendation: Create an FR for the debug portal or remove the pseudo-Verifies comment.

p3_findings.title: DependencyPicker.tsx Mixes Domain Cycle-Detection Logic with React Rendering
p3_findings.recommendation: Extract useDependencyPicker hook or pure utility function for cycle-detection logic.
